reason: B offers the more physically plausible and testable intervention: controlled liquid-phase sintering can densify and improve Cu-network connectivity while leaving the load-bearing W skeleton largely intact, with microscopy and property tests directly assessing the proposed mediator and trade-offs. A is weakened because Ag wets/bonds W poorly, may dissolve into Cu during consolidation, and has unsubstantiated irradiation stability, so the claimed persistent low-resistance interface is doubtful; neither candidate supplies the requested prior evidence.
